samples.question: The image shows a network of black connection points (filled dots) joined by black links. A point is a cut point if removing it and all of its links would split the network into more separate pieces than before. Exactly one of the red and blue highlighted dots is a cut point. Consider removing the red dot (and its links) and then removing the blue dot (and its links). For only one of those two dots does the network split into more pieces. Which dot is it: red or blue? Answer with exactly red or blue.
